name: Layout Grid
description: The frame splits into an asymmetric magazine grid as paper gutters open between the panels; panel after panel in reading order, the second clip pushes the first out of its panel from a different side, a colored accent band between them, then the gutters close over the full second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: gutter
params.description: Width of the gutters at their widest, as a part of the frame's shorter side

params.name: overlap
params.description: How much the panels' pushes overlap in time (0: one strictly after another)

params.name: band
params.description: Length of the accent band between the two clips, as a part of the panel's length along its push

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the soft shadows the panels cast on the paper and on the band

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the paper seen in the gutters

params.name: accent
params.description: Color of the accent band between the two clips
